targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    mp.timestamp AS "time",
    mp.value AS value,
    md.metric_name AS metric
FROM metric_points mp
JOIN metric_definitions md
    ON md.id = mp.metric_definition_id
WHERE
    md.namespace = 'AWS/ApiGateway'
    AND md.metric_name = 'Count'
    AND md.resource_id = ${resource_id:sqlstring}
    AND md.region = ${region:sqlstring}
    AND $__timeFilter(mp.timestamp)
ORDER BY mp.timestamp;

SELECT
    mp.timestamp AS "time",
    mp.value AS value,
    md.metric_name AS metric
FROM metric_points mp
JOIN metric_definitions md
    ON md.id = mp.metric_definition_id
WHERE
    md.namespace = 'AWS/ApiGateway'
    AND md.metric_name = '4XXError'
    AND md.resource_id = ${resource_id:sqlstring}
    AND md.region = ${region:sqlstring}
    AND $__timeFilter(mp.timestamp)
ORDER BY mp.timestamp;

SELECT
    mp.timestamp AS "time",
    mp.value AS value,
    md.metric_name AS metric
FROM metric_points mp
JOIN metric_definitions md
    ON md.id = mp.metric_definition_id
WHERE
    md.namespace = 'AWS/ApiGateway'
    AND md.metric_name = '5XXError'
    AND md.resource_id = ${resource_id:sqlstring}
    AND md.region = ${region:sqlstring}
    AND $__timeFilter(mp.timestamp)
ORDER BY mp.timestamp;

SELECT
    mp.timestamp AS "time",
    mp.value AS value,
    md.metric_name AS metric
FROM metric_points mp
JOIN metric_definitions md
    ON md.id = mp.metric_definition_id
WHERE
    md.namespace = 'AWS/ApiGateway'
    AND md.metric_name = 'Latency'
    AND md.resource_id = ${resource_id:sqlstring}
    AND md.region = ${region:sqlstring}
    AND $__timeFilter(mp.timestamp)
ORDER BY mp.timestamp;

SELECT
    mp.timestamp AS "time",
    mp.value AS value,
    md.metric_name AS metric
FROM metric_points mp
JOIN metric_definitions md
    ON md.id = mp.metric_definition_id
WHERE
    md.namespace = 'AWS/ApiGateway'
    AND md.metric_name = 'IntegrationLatency'
    AND md.resource_id = ${resource_id:sqlstring}
    AND md.region = ${region:sqlstring}
    AND $__timeFilter(mp.timestamp)
ORDER BY mp.timestamp;

SELECT
    md.metric_name,
    md.statistic,
    md.period_seconds,
    count(mp.id) AS points,
    max(mp.timestamp) AS latest_point
FROM metric_definitions md
LEFT JOIN metric_points mp
    ON mp.metric_definition_id = md.id
    AND $__timeFilter(mp.timestamp)
WHERE
    md.namespace = 'AWS/ApiGateway'
    AND md.resource_id = ${resource_id:sqlstring}
    AND md.region = ${region:sqlstring}
GROUP BY md.metric_name, md.statistic, md.period_seconds
ORDER BY md.metric_name;
